_readme: Questions Jev asks in the hook strategy check, comparing what the creator says in the opening of their top Shorts with their latest ones. top[] and latest[] each hold { title, opening }, where opening is the first ~45 seconds of what is said. {i} is replaced with each latest Short's index. Latest Shorts are judged on hook patterns, never on views: they haven't had time to build up views yet.

follows.instructions: Does `latest[{i}].opening` grab attention the same way most of the openings in `top` do? Judge only the hook pattern (how the first lines pull the viewer in), not the topic, wording, or views.

closeness.instructions: Taken together, how closely do the openings in `latest` follow the hook patterns of the openings in `top`? Judge only how the openings pull the viewer in, not the topics or the views.
criteria: They open in clearly different ways from the top performers
Some follow the winning hook patterns and some don't
They mostly open the way the top performers do
